verdict.rationale: Direct probes show a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the Edison Scientific docs as .md links. The docs page itself serves a Markdown version that points agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be aimed at either. Missing for 10: any first-party guidance on using llms.txt or the Markdown docs with agents, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and independent corroboration beyond automated probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
